en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of an exhibition booth, likely at a fair or exposition. The booth displays large, ornate woven carpets and textiles on the walls, with several women dressed in traditional folk costumes. Two women appear to be working at a loom, demonstrating the weaving process. There is a sign above that reads 'LITAUISCHE TEPPICHE' (Lithuanian Carpets). The bottom of the postcard contains the following text: 'Litauen Internat. Handwerks-Ausstellung Berlin 1938.'
